slippage_sensitivity.assumption: full chronological portfolio re-simulation from $100 for each fixed T-59 price shift; T-60 decisions stay causal and unchanged, while execution eligibility, later free-cash stakes, fills, and trades are recalculated; trade sets can differ

summary.drawdown_accounting: cash plus original gross cost basis of unsettled positions; settlement changes equity to cash payout, and no interim mark-to-market is imputed
summary.expected_value: payout probability times net shares less full gross spend and cash collateral fee; optional T-60 hurdle is net EV divided by requested gross stake
summary.settlement_release: max(Gamma closedTime, market start + 5 minutes) + 60 seconds; same convention for all policies
summary.side_selection_rule: positive net EV side at requested amount
